item.title: Halloween: The Game
item.description:
Title: Halloween: The Game
Genre: Action
Developer: IllFonic
Publisher: IllFonic Publishing , Co-Publisher: Gun Interactive
Release Date: Sep 8, 2026




About This Game

  • Take The Shape of Evil: Target, stalk, and terrorize the residents of Haddonfield as the iconic Michael Myers.

  • Become a Hero of Haddonfield: Arm yourself with weapons and everyday household items to fend off the impending evil, alert the authorities, and rescue the innocent families of Haddonfield.

  • Experience the Ultimate Horror Sandbox: An expansive array of dynamic map features, distinct gameplay systems, life-like NPC interactions, and player abilities elevates the horror sandbox like never before.

  • Singleplayer Slashing: Immerse yourself in the haunting narrative events of "The Night He Came Home" through the eyes of Michael Myers in a standalone singleplayer story.

  • Elevated Asymmetrical Multiplayer: Cooperate with up to four players as the Heroes of Haddonfield and face off against the one and only Michael Myers in unpredictable multiplayer matches unfolding within a living, breathing game world.

It’s Halloween night, 1978, the unsuspecting families of the quiet suburban town of Haddonfield are making holiday preparations, and evil has made its way home. Take The Shape of Evil as Michael Myers or save your neighbors as a Hero of Haddonfield in Halloween, the ultimate asymmetrical horror sandbox.

As Michael, players wear the mask, become the Boogeyman, and stalk innocent residents with relentless obsession. Utilizing a nightmarish array of abilities, Michael leverages shadows and stealth to satisfy his bloodthirst. This doesn’t mean Haddonfield is going down without a fight. Frightened townsfolk will call the local authorities and even fight back when threatened, incentivizing Michael to avoid detection. And for the first time ever, fans of the transformative original film will have the option to witness the haunting narrative events surrounding "The Night He Came Home" through the eyes of Michael Myers in a standalone singleplayer story mode.

As a Hero of Haddonfield, it’s your job to alert the residents of Haddonfield to the impending evil and help them escape before falling victim to Michael’s unyielding pursuit. In dynamic and ever-changing 1v4 asymmetrical multiplayer matches, hero players must arm themselves with everyday household items, weapons, and knowledge to combat an unpredictable and unkillable enemy. Convincing townsfolk and contacting the police will lead to increasingly powerful and thorough neighborhood patrols. To even the odds, you can command and equip NPCs with weapons to outsmart or even overpower The Shape, providing precious windows for escape.

This immersive horror sandbox is powered by Unreal Engine 5 to deliver engaging and dynamic gameplay systems, life-like NPCs, hauntingly realistic visuals, cinema-quality lighting, and endless scares for you and your friends. Asymmetrical horror comes home in Halloween.

Mature Content Description

The developers describe the content like this:

Halloween: The Game includes frequent graphical violence throughout singleplayer and multiplayer. Blood and gore are present, and violence is frequent. Players can consume beer and smoke marijuana from their inventory. Some nudity occurs during single player.



System Requirements

Windows

    Minimum:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
    • Processor: Intel LGA 1200+ / AMD AM4+ (Zen 2+)
    • Memory: 16 GB RAM
    • Graphics: GTX 1660+ / RX 590+ / Arc A770+ (1080p@30fps)
    • DirectX: Version 12
    • Network: Broadband Internet connection
    • Storage: 45 GB available space
    • Additional Notes: SSD/NVME Required
    Recommended:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
    • Processor: Intel LGA 1700+ / AMD AM5+
    • Memory: 32 GB RAM
    • Graphics: RTX 3000 series / RX 7000 series (4k@30fps)
    • DirectX: Version 12
    • Network: Broadband Internet connection
    • Storage: 45 GB available space
    • Additional Notes: SSD/NVME Required

item.title: Honeycomb: The World Beyond
item.description:
Title: Honeycomb: The World Beyond
Genre: Adventure , Casual , Indie
Developer: Frozen Way
Publisher: Snail Games USA
Franchise: Snail Games USA
Release Date: Sep 8, 2026




About This Game

EXPLORE. EXPERIMENT. ADAPT.

Welcome to the world of Honeycomb! Step into the role of Hennessy, a bioengineer sent to an alien world in search of knowledge that could help secure humanity’s future. Your mission for EON Corp will take you across the vibrant wilderness of Sota7 - a planet filled with unfamiliar ecosystems, extraordinary lifeforms, valuable resources, and dangers you were never trained for.

DISCOVER A LIVING ALIEN WORLD

Sota7 may be beautiful, but it is not harmless. Some creatures may tolerate your presence. Others won’t. Learn when to approach, when to keep your distance, and when running is the smartest experiment you can perform.

From vast open landscapes to hidden underground caverns, Sota7 is home to diverse biomes filled with strange plants and creatures. Study the world around you, learn how its ecosystems work, and uncover the properties of newly discovered species. Curiosity is one of your greatest tools - but on Sota7, getting too close can have consequences.

BECOME A BIOENGINEER

Discovery is only the beginning. Use bioengineering to synthesize unique plant properties and manipulate animal DNA to trigger fascinating physical changes. Experiment with different combinations, analyze the results, and use what you learn to push your research further. The right breakthrough could change your mission - or humanity’s future.

BUILD YOUR BASE OF OPERATIONS

But a scientist needs more than a notebook. Gather resources and establish a base where you can live, work, craft, and conduct experiments. Expand your facilities as your research grows and use your tools to help turn your designs into a functioning base of operations. Build what you need, where you need it, and prepare for longer expeditions into the unknown.

SURVIVE THE UNKNOWN

Every expedition is an opportunity. Search Sota7 for useful materials, craft the equipment you need, and keep an eye out for resources that can improve your chances of survival. The deeper you venture, the more you’ll need to understand the planet - and prepare for what might be waiting there. Because remember - the environment isn’t always your best friend.

FEATURES

  • Exploration - Sota7 has vast, diverse biomes, each with different plants and animals for you to discover. Scan various flora and fauna to learn more about this world and how you can adapt to survive in it.

  • Crossbreeding - as an EON-certified bioengineer, you are qualified to perform various experiments, from synthesizing plant properties to mutating animal traits! And who knows, maybe the answer to Earth’s Eco Crisis lies on Sota7?

  • Building - a scientist, especially on an alien planet, needs their base of operations. IVS will provide you with blueprints needed to live comfortably and efficiently.

  • Survival - as beautiful as Sota7 is, it is still a completely new world with its own rules and adversities. Perform research in order to discover how to make sure you don’t perish during your mission.

item.title: SPRAWL zero
item.description:
Title: SPRAWL zero
Genre: Action
Developer: MAETH
Publisher: Kwalee
Franchise: Kwalee
Release Date: Sep 8, 2026




About This Game

SPRAWL zero is a first-person shooter inspired by 2000s console FPS games. Both the aesthetics and design sensibility call back to the Golden Age, where the genre evolved from shooting in corridors to building worlds.

You play as FIVE, a cybernetically enhanced supersoldier controlled by the Junta. Your directive is to eliminate SILAS, leader of the radical techno-religious group IMAGO-DEI. The city will plunge into chaos as all factions known and unknown grasp for the reins. Reconcile your truths or succumb to the SPRAWL.

Combat in SPRAWL zero is fast-paced but grounded. Enemy squads will communicate and coordinate to wrestle the advantage. Flanks, covering fire, and grenades will flush you out, creating dynamic firefights inspired by classics like F.E.A.R. and Halo.

In your hands, FIVE must outsmart and outmaneuver the opposition using any advantage possible. Catch their bullets and throw them right back with the Gravity Shield, or bend your shots midair with Bullet-Time for inhuman precision. A massive arsenal of weapons and FIVE’s cybernetics are your tools of destruction.

Gravity Gloves, Gravity Shield, and Rushdown expand combat beyond gunplay, enabling aggressive pushes, defensive play, and physics-driven encounters. No problem has just one solution.

Handcrafted levels feature multiple paths, verticality, and alternate approaches, rewarding experimentation and replayability. Push aggressively, play tactically from cover, or dominate encounters through physics-based combat. Player agency was a fundamental pillar of Y2K design, and SPRAWL zero accommodates players to find their own niche.

Key Features

  • Truly dynamic FPS combat inspired by classic console shooters

  • Smart, coordinated enemy behavior that flanks, communicates, and adapts

  • Physics interactions with gravity-based combat systems that expand play beyond gunfire

  • Player expression to find your own path to victory

  • Stylish Bullet-Time to never miss a shot

  • Gravity Shield to catch and return enemy gunfire

  • Rushdown enemies with invulnerability and destructive force

  • Wide arsenal of over 40 weapons with distinct roles and mastery paths

  • Diverse roster of enemies, with multiple factions spread across grounded and airborne, organic and mechanical.

  • Masterfully crafted levels with multiple routes and verticality

  • Gritty, grounded cyberpunk world and tone

  • Authentic Y2K aesthetics and graphics, paying homage to the golden era

  • Industry-leading sound design

  • Original soundtrack of intense music hearkening back to the early 2000s

Mature Content Description

The developers describe the content like this:

Contains Graphic Violence



System Requirements

Windows

    Minimum:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
    • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
    • Memory: 16 GB RAM
    • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti or AMD Radeon RX 570
    • DirectX: Version 12
    • Storage: 4 GB available space
    Recommended:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
    • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400 or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
    • Memory: 16 GB RAM
    • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 Ti or AMD Radeon RX 6500 XT
    • DirectX: Version 12
    • Storage: 4 GB available space

item.title: Wanderburg
item.description:
Title: Wanderburg
Genre: Action , Casual , Indie , RPG , Simulation , Strategy , Free To Play , Early Access
Developer: Randwerk
Publisher: Sidekick Publishing
Release Date: Sep 8, 2026
Early Access Release Date: Sep 8, 2026




About This Game

Castles weren’t built to move. Now they do.

Wanderburg is a fast-paced, minimalist roguelike set in a medieval world of roaming fortresses. Castles hunt, Villages flee. And only the biggest stronghold survives. What begins as a modest moving fortress quickly becomes a growing, devouring war machine that reshapes the battlefield with every run.

Roll forward and consume everything in your path. Fleeing villages, wandering flocks and smaller fortresses all feed your growth. Defeat powerful enemy castles to push your evolution further. Your castle does not just upgrade - it expands.

Steam-powered siege engines roll beside arcane artillery. Knights ride bicycles into battle. Massive strongholds fire broadsides like warships on land. And somewhere beyond the hills, something bigger is already on the move.

Build your modular arsenal piece by piece. Break the game while you're at it. Mount cannons, raise arcane towers staffed with wizards, deploy explosives, and experiment with wildly different builds each run. Between runs, unlock new modules and vehicles that open up fresh strategies and game-breaking combinations.

A modular progression system lets you expand your moving fortress with new siege modules and structures, while unlockable vehicles, artifacts and captains between runs steadily widen your strategic options and build variety.

Fully playable with mouse, keyboard, or controller and highly optimized for almost anything you throw at it.

item.title: Orc Incremental
item.description:
Title: Orc Incremental
Genre: Adventure , Indie , RPG , Simulation , Strategy
Developer: Nice Ride
Publisher: Playsaurus
Franchise: Playsaurus
Release Date: Sep 8, 2026




About This Game

The incremental auto battler. Build an orc army, watch it fight, and make it unstoppable!

Orc Incremental puts you in command of a growing warband of dark forces. Recruit all kinds of units, set formations, draw powerful cards, and ascend for permanent power bonuses to make every run hit harder than the last. Idle progression meets real tactical decisions, and it never stops scaling.

DRAFT YOUR ARMY

Draw cards to add units and totems to your warband. Units come in multiple rarities and fill different battlefield roles, and the right mix is what gets you past the next wall. Totems provide passive bonuses that can change how your whole army performs. Every card you pick shapes your composition and pushes your run in a different direction.

SET YOUR FORMATION. LET THEM LOOSE.

Your army marches forward and fights on its own. When your strategy is working, you watch it rip through wave after wave. When you hit a wall, rethink your lineup or swap in new units.

CAST SPELLS. BREAK THROUGH.

You can support your army with spells. Drop a Blizzard to slow a boss that's tearing through your frontline, or land a Fireball at the right moment to close out a fight you were about to lose.

ASCEND. RETURN STRONGER.

At some point your army stops being enough. That's when you ascend (Dark Rebirth). Reset your run, keep permanent bonuses (for damage, health, gold, etc.) and unlock new units and challenges that weren't available before. The early game opens up as your power grows, and the later milestones keep pushing you further. Every Dark Rebirth makes you stronger and opens up new goals.

KEY FEATURES

- Build and scale an orc army from a single grunt to an unstoppable warband

- Set up your formation, push until you hit a wall, then rethink and reorganize

- Draft units and totems with different rarities, roles, and synergies to shape your composition

- Cast spells during tough battles to turn the tide at critical moments

- Ascend for permanent power bonuses, new unit unlocks, and challenges that change how you play. Every ascension you get to choose a chieftain that makes every run unique.

- Go offline. Come back to a pile of gold and a stronger army waiting for you.

- Boss milestones that put your army to the test

- Handmade assets. No AI used!

Mature Content Description

The developers describe the content like this:

Contains stylized fantasy combat, battle themes, and dark fantasy elements involving orc armies, monsters, and magic.



System Requirements

Windows

    Minimum:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows 10 or later
    • Processor: 2.0 GHz dual-core processor
    • Memory: 2 GB RAM
    • Graphics: Integrated Graphics
    • DirectX: Version 12
    • Storage: 200 MB available space
    Recommended:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows 10 or later
    • Processor: 2.0 GHz dual-core processor
    • Memory: 4 GB RAM
    • Graphics: Integrated Graphics
    • DirectX: Version 12
    • Storage: 500 MB available space

Reset your run, keep permanent bonuses (for damage, health, gold, etc.) and unlock new units and challenges that weren't available before. The early game opens up as your power grows, and the later milestones keep pushing you further. Every Dark Rebirth makes you stronger and opens up new goals.

KEY FEATURES

- Build and scale an orc army from a single grunt to an unstoppable warband

- Set up your formation, push until you hit a wall, then rethink and reorganize

- Draft units and totems with different rarities, roles, and synergies to shape your composition

- Cast spells during tough battles to turn the tide at critical moments

- Ascend for permanent power bonuses, new unit unlocks, and challenges that change how you play. Every ascension you get to choose a chieftain that makes every run unique.

- Go offline. Come back to a pile of gold and a stronger army waiting for you.

- Boss milestones that put your army to the test

- Handmade assets. No AI used!

Mature Content Description

Contains stylized fantasy combat, battle themes, and dark fantasy elements involving orc armies, monsters, and magic.
